text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT: page fired for service=embeddings-prod (P1) — sustained 5xx spike > 15% in eu-west-1. PD: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345 :rotating_light:

pagerbot: Auto-ack attempt sent to primary oncall. If not acknowledged in 30s, escalations will follow.

alex.k: I’m on it, grabbing logs + checking routing. Starting with inference-embed pool in eu-west-1.

maria.s: tagging @sanjay_cs for customer impact — any large customers on eu-west today?

lee_oncall: I can jump in if you need a hand, on rotation now.

alex.k: quick snapshot: errors are 502/504 from embedder pods. CPU fine, memory high on shard-3. Stack shows repeated OOM-suppress exceptions in runtime: 
```
2026-03-14T10:12:07Z ERROR embedder-runtime - kv-cache-miss, retry, exception: CUDA OOM
2026-03-14T10:12:08Z WARN  grpc - 502 from model-server-3
```

alex.k: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide` shows embedder-3 restarting 12x in last 5m. node gpu-10 reporting 90% memory, kernel oom kills.

ops-shiftlead: any recent deploys? deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: No deploys to embeddings-prod in the last 4 hours.

maria.s: customer impact — AcmeCorp (customer_id: acme-42) is ~30% of traffic through eu-west and is seeing failures. Sanjay, can you start a status message?

sanjay_cs: on it — drafting now. ETA 5m.

lee_oncall: Proposal: failover traffic for embeddings to dedicated regional pool (dedicated-eu-west) and enable caching fallback for requests with stale cache. This should reduce error surface quickly. We can toggle at the routing layer: 
```yaml
route_policy: 
  service: embeddings-prod
  fallback: dedicated-eu-west
  cutoff_rate: 0.2
  drain_timeout: 30s
```

alex.k: +1 to routing change. I’ll also scale down parallelism on problematic nodes and mark node gpu-10 unschedulable. Running `kubectl cordon gpu-10` now.

alex.k: command outputs: 
```
$ kubectl cordon node/gpu-10
node/gpu-10 cordoned
$ kubectl scale deployment/embedder --replicas=6 -n inference
deployment.extensions/embedder scaled
```

pagerbot: Routing toggle request queued. Confirm `--apply` to promote fallback (this will route ~20% traffic initially).

lee_oncall: Confirm apply. I’ll watch latency and error graphs.

pagerbot: Routing change applied by lee_oncall at 10:18Z. Traffic cutover initiated: +20% -> dedicated-eu-west.

alex.k: Initial metrics: 5xx rate down from 18% -> 6% in 2min. Latency stable. Nodes still recycling but overall errors dropping.

maria.s: sending out status update to Acme: "We detected elevated errors affecting embeddings in eu-west; mitigation in progress by routing a portion of traffic to a dedicated pool. We'll provide updates every 15 minutes."

sanjay_cs: sent — customer acknowledged and asked for ETA for full remediation.

ops-shiftlead: next steps: 1) keep routing fallback for 30m, 2) replace gpu-10 (hardware suspected), 3) prepare rollback plan if errors spike.

alex.k: I’ve opened infra ticket INFRA-8921 to repro machine-level OOM and schedule replacement. Pinning pod placement away from gpu-10.

lee_oncall: I’m happy to stay on this for the next 30 mins while we stabilize, then hand back to rotation. If issues resurface, escalate to hw-oncall.

maria.s: Can we capture a short customer-facing blurb for status page? Keep to: cause (hardware OOM on shard node), impact (acme and eu-west customers), mitigation (traffic diverted, node cordoned), next update (in 15m).

alex.k: logging snippet for the postmortem capture: 
```
root_cause_hints:
  - repeated CUDA OOM when kv-cache grows beyond threshold
  - pod anti-affinity allowed multiple heavy shards on same GPU host
mitigation_applied:
  - cordoned node/gpu-10
  - scaled embedder replicas
  - enabled routing fallback to dedicated-eu-west (20%)
```

pagerbot: PD incident PD12345 remains acknowledged by alex.k and lee_oncall. Escalation timer paused.

sanjay_cs: Acme asked if we can provide logs for their internal SRE — will follow up with sanitized logs after incident.

maria.s: assigning postmortem owner: alex.k. Please include timeline, contributing factors, and action items (anti-affinity tightening, emergency scaling guardrails, node healthchecks).

alex.k: ack, will own PM. Will start drafting while stabilizing.

lee_oncall: leaving handoff note — I’ll stay until 10:40Z then hand back to regular rotation. ping me if errors >10% again.

incident-bot: Reminder: add incident label `P1-embeddings-eu` and create incident channel if needed.

alex.k: thanks team. Current status: mitigated (partial) — errors down, routing fallback active, hardware ticket opened. Continuing monitoring. Will post next update at 10:30Z. :white_check_mark:

maria.s: :thumbsup: great coordination.

sanjay_cs: leaving note for CS handoff — will be on standby for customer comms through the afternoon.

lee_oncall: last check at 10:28Z looks stable. I’m going to sleep a bit but reachable.

pagerbot: Automatic close timer set for PD12345 in 2h if no regression.

alex.k: last update before handoff: creating a short runbook snippet for oncall: 
- If 5xx > 10% in any region: toggle routing fallback 20% -> dedicated pool, cordon suspected nodes, scale replica count down/up, notify CS.

alex.k: handing primary to ops-shiftlead at 10:36Z for follow-up actions.

ops-shiftlead: taking ownership for follow-up and post-incident tasks. Closing thread once postmortem links are added.

---
(End of thread)
